entities.title: The utv-result/1.0 JSON the library writes
entities.summary: UtvResult and its ToJson(): the C# form of the evaluation-result envelope every JSON-layer operation returns.
consumers: Applications that store or send results as JSON
The shared everyday and text-form fixtures, which compare status, candidates and diagnostic codes
guarantees: ToJson writes, in this order, schema (utv-result/1.0), operation, status, candidates, manifest (dependencies), assumptions, loss (classification, fields) and diagnostics ({code, severity, path, message}).
operation is the everyday operation's name (validate, parseIso, add, resolve, …; fromDateTime for interop).
status is a wire string of UtvStatus; none has no candidates and unique exactly one, enforced by the constructor.
multiple lists its candidates in ascending order.
Candidates are UTV values, or plain JSON for answers that are a string, number or object (formatIso, compare, fields, daysBetween, contains, overlaps).
Diagnostic paths are RFC 6901 JSON Pointers into the input; codes follow the shared table of docs/library-api.md §5, plus the 0.1 structural codes and offset-not-known.
manifest is always empty, assumptions always empty and loss always lossless (see decisions.json, empty-manifest).
entities.compatibility: Follows spec/RESULT-CONTRACT.md for the wire form; the operation names extend its list (OI-17). Diagnostic codes changed from 0.2 to 0.3 to follow the shared table, as the CHANGELOG records; such changes are allowed before 1.0.0 and are listed in CHANGELOG.md.
